fields.description: Serve Kamra's screens with the customisations. Turn off to serve Kamra's original screens.
fields.label: Use customised Kamra screens

fields.description: Print the name of the staff member who checked the guest in, and a mark when the guest signed the printed card, on the registration card (GRC). Before check-in the GRC shows the room category only.
fields.label: Staff name and room category on the registration card

fields.description: Show a Check-out date box beside Nights when making a reservation. Changing one changes the other.
fields.label: Check-out date when making a reservation

fields.description: A negotiated room rate that is more than this percent below the system rate needs a Revenue Manager or Hotel Admin. 0 means every discount needs one.
fields.label: Largest discount the front desk can give

fields.description: A new reservation holds a room type, not a room. The room is chosen at check-in. Walk-ins still get a room at once.
fields.label: Assign the room at check-in

fields.description: Refuse to check a guest in to a room that housekeeping has not marked Clean, Inspected or Ready.
fields.label: Check in to clean rooms only

fields.description: Restaurant orders of a complimentary guest are marked NC: they are recorded and shown in the complimentary report, and no money is asked for.
fields.label: Restaurant orders of complimentary guests are NC

fields.description: On the printed bill, show the meal inside the room line of each night (Room with Continental Plan) instead of a separate Meal Plan line. The tax summary still lists every tax rate. Check with your accountant first.
fields.label: Print the meal inside the room line

fields.description: Check in on two pages instead of six steps. Page 1: ID and room. Page 2: signature. Name, ID, room and signature are the only things asked. The hotel takes an advance, not a deposit, so no deposit is asked.
fields.label: Two-page check-in
